episodes.synopsis: Princess Syalis is abducted from her home of the Nation of Goodereste by Twilight the Demon King. Despite the horrors lurking in the Demon Castle, all Princess Syalis wants is a good night’s sleep.
episodes.title: Sleepless Princess of the Castle

episodes.synopsis: As Dawner the Hero faces perilous obstacles to rescue Princess Syalis, the princess continues to find creative ways to sleep more comfortably at the Demon Castle.
episodes.title: The Princess and Furious Fluff

episodes.synopsis: Princess Syalis is on the loose again meddling with forbidden magical items and causing total mayhem for the Demon Castle.
episodes.title: The Princess and Forbidden Knowledge

episodes.synopsis: Fed up with her circumstances at the Demon Castle, Princess Syalis goes to great lengths to add luxuries to her castle prison.
episodes.title: The Princess, Destruction, and a Short Journey

episodes.synopsis: The female unit, long deployed out in the field, has returned to the Demon Castle to get their first taste of Princess Syalis.
episodes.title: The Princess and Female Warriors

episodes.synopsis: Dawner the Hero is having more trouble than expected on his journey to the Demon Castle, so the demon higher ups decide to take some action.
episodes.title: The Princess’ Unwavering Choice

episodes.synopsis: Princess Syalis wakes to find herself in a completely different castle! What happened and how will she return to the Demon Castle?
episodes.title: Even More Sleepless Princess of the Castle

episodes.synopsis: Back at the Demon Castle, Princess Syalis interrupts an important meeting to share about her haunted dreams.
episodes.title: The Princess and the Frightful Demon Nightmare

episodes.synopsis: It’s time for Princess Syalis to start acting like a proper hostage, so the demon king issues a decree to help change that.
episodes.title: The Princess and Hostage Training Week

episodes.synopsis: Princes Syalis is determined to get her hands on the latest and greatest sleep product, but it’s only available in the Human Realm.
episodes.title: The Princess in Endopolis

episodes.synopsis: Princess Syalis feels tired no matter how much sleep she gets, and her troubling dreams aren’t helping.
episodes.title: The Princess and Troubling Dreams

episodes.synopsis: Despite living as a captive in the Demon Realm, the princess writes a letter to Santa. The letter’s contents shock the demon king.
episodes.title: Sleeping Princess of the Demon Castle
